originalTitle: Horizon Industrial Parks IPO opens today: Check GMP, price band and key details
simplifiedContent: Horizon Industrial Parks is starting a process to raise money from the public by selling its shares, which is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). The IPO starts today and will close on August 19, with the price of each share set between Rs 57 and Rs 60. The company hopes to raise Rs 2,600 crore, mostly to pay off its debts. Recently, the company's income increased by 75%, but it still reported a loss of Rs 203 crore. This IPO is a chance for individual investors to buy shares in the company, but it's worth noting that the company is currently losing money.

originalTitle: Behari Lal Engineering allotment likely today; GMP at 30%. Here’s how to check status
simplifiedContent: Behari Lal Engineering, a company that recently had an Initial Public Offering (IPO), is expected to announce who will get the shares they applied for today. The IPO was for ₹302-crore, which is a large amount of money. Investors can check if they got the shares by visiting the company's registrar website or the stock exchange websites. The company's shares are expected to do well, with a 30% "grey market premium" (GMP), which means people think the stock will be valuable. This is important because it suggests that the stock might start trading at a higher price than expected when it is listed.

originalTitle: Shiprocket IPO allotment likely today; GMP signals 33% listing gain. Here’s how to check status
simplifiedContent: The company Shiprocket is going to announce who got shares in its initial public offering (IPO) today. The IPO was very popular, with almost 99 times more people wanting to buy shares than there were shares available. Because of this, the price of the shares is expected to be about 33% higher than the original price when they start trading. This means that people who bought shares in the IPO might make a profit when they can start selling them. The company will soon tell investors whether they got the shares they applied for, and they can check their status online.

originalTitle: Gold Rises to Near $4,400 as Weak Retail Data Weighs on Dollar
simplifiedContent: The price of gold has gone up and is now close to $4,400. This happened because sales at stores in the US were weaker than expected, which made the value of the US dollar go down. When the dollar is weaker, gold is cheaper for people in other countries to buy, so they are more likely to buy it, which drives up the price. This is important because it shows how the overall health of the US economy can affect the value of gold. As a result, investors are paying more attention to gold as its price continues to rise.

originalTitle: Stocks to buy for short term: BDL, Bata India among 3 shares Anand Rathi's Jigar Patel recommends for the next 1-2 weeks
simplifiedContent: Anand Rathi's expert, Jigar Patel, is suggesting that investors consider buying shares in three companies: Aarti Industries, Bata India, and BDL. He thinks these stocks could be good investments for a short period of time, around 1-2 weeks. Patel has identified specific price levels where investors should buy these stocks and also set "stop-losses", which are like safety nets to limit potential losses. This means he's trying to help investors make the most of potential gains while minimizing risks. By following his advice, investors may be able to make some profit in a short amount of time.

originalTitle: Tempsens Instruments IPO: Price band set at  ₹285-300 per share; check key dates, issue details
simplifiedContent: Tempsens Instruments is having an Initial Public Offering (IPO), which means it's selling shares to the public for the first time. The company has set a price range of ₹285 to ₹300 per share, so that's how much you'll have to pay if you want to buy some. The sale of shares will start on August 20 and end on August 24, and the company expects the shares to be listed on the stock exchanges on August 28. This is important because it gives regular people a chance to invest in the company, and those who are interested can prepare to buy shares during the given time frame. The listing on the stock exchanges will allow shareholders to buy and sell shares easily after the IPO.
